title: Company cash, delivery pay and primary industry growth (vehicle prices live in vehicles.json)

startingCash.description: Company cash granted to a new world.

deliveryPay.description: A delivery pays price x units x paid distance / referenceDistance. The distance is the Manhattan tiles between the station where the load started and the delivery station; the paid distance counts them in full up to fullPayDistance and beyondFullPayPercent of each tile beyond it, rounded down to whole tiles.

referenceDistance.description: Paid distance in tiles at which a unit pays exactly its price; 0 means flat pay.

minimumDistance.description: Shortest distance paid for, also used when the load origin is unknown.

fullPayDistance.description: Tiles paid in full (not below minimumDistance).

beyondFullPayPercent.description: Percent of each tile beyond fullPayDistance that still counts as paid distance.

industryGrowth.description: Primary industries that deliver at least servedPercent of their monthly production for monthsToGrow months in a row gain a tier, up to maxLevel (zero-based, shown to the player from 1); each tier multiplies the output and the stock capacity by levelMultiplier.
